_comment: Declarative walk specs for scripts/query_skill_map.py — the two-tier query layer's second tier (materialized generated/skill-map.indexes.json covers hot paths; these seven named queries cover everything else). Cypher-shaped without Cypher: start set -> edge steps -> output, so a spec ports mechanically if the map ever moves to a real graph DB. One Python walker interprets this file; hooks never use it (see docs/skill-map.md's query layer section).

what-extends.description: Given a skill id, what it extends (deepens) and what extends it.

what-augments.description: Given a skill id, the topic tags it augments; given a tag:topic/<slug> id, the skills that augment it.

what-remediates.description: Given a condition slug (or a full tag:condition/<slug> id), the skills declaring a remediates edge to it.

what-follows.description: Given a skill id, mined follows relationships: what tends to be invoked after it, and what it tends to follow. Only populated against the resolved map (--resolved) — follows edges are local-overlay only.

overlap-candidates.description: Every overlaps-with edge in the map — curation flags for skills covering meaningfully similar ground.

unroutable-skills.description: Skills with no topic-tag and no stack-tag edges — invisible to skill-router.js and session-disclosure.js.

mcp-dependents.description: Given an mcp server name (or a full mcp:<name> id), the skills declaring a depends-on edge to it.
